implementation.name: Neo Geo (Analogue Pocket, Mazamars312)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 237 HDL source files (11 systemverilog, 208 verilog, 18 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Neo Geo MVS board and AES console, giving machine_id neogeo and machine_id aes, each checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file at its root and no licence grant was found in the HDL headers read (src/NeoGeo Cart/BACKUP_APF.v, src/NeoGeo Cart/BACKUP_APF_bb.v, src/NeoGeo Cart/LO_RAM.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 237 source files (11 systemverilog, 208 verilog, 18 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/Mazamars312.NeoGeo/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier Mazamars312.NeoGeo.
